init_hook: echo 'Welcome to DSS devbox. Run `devbox run test` or `devbox run dev`'

setup: devbox services up -b || echo 'services are already running'
RAILS_ENV=development bundle exec rake db:create db:migrate db:seed
RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rake db:create db:migrate db:seed
RAILS_ENV=development bundle exec rake dss:solr:index || true
db:rebuild: RAILS_ENV=development bundle exec rake db:drop db:create db:migrate db:seed
RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rake db:drop db:create db:migrate db:seed
delete_solr_collections: curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/dss-core-dev/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'dss-core-dev core was already deleted'

curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/dss-core-test/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'dss-core-test core was already deleted'
